notes: Hotfix. 0.36.0 could not load its WebAssembly module in a browser, so font conversion, the WOFF2 decoder and the metrics reader were all dead; the decoder had added an import the glue leaves undefined, and the build now compiles with NDEBUG. It also lost Generated CSS, Variants and Add variant from every Google family's editor, restyled the panel's own headings, and hid Etch's settings-bar tooltips behind the manager. Apply to is typeable again, a font read that cannot answer gives up after twenty seconds rather than two minutes, Override theme styles disables instead of disappearing, and a family's typography role reads as a badge. Everyone on 0.36.0 should take this.
